description: This class defines a MapShape in the AWS SDK for PHP, representing a map data structure within the API shape definitions. It provides methods to access the key and value shapes related to the map and inherits from a base Shape class.

classes.name: MapShape
classes.description: Represents a map shape in the AWS SDK, handling key-value pair definitions and shape creation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a MapShape instance, setting its type to 'map' and calling the parent constructor.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the shape of the map's value, creating it if it hasn't been initialized.

methods.name: getKey
methods.description: Returns the shape of the map's key, creating it if it hasn't been initialized.
